name: REAL WALLET: connect asks first (gate), then reaches the wallet; account change and DISCONNECT (revocation) work; only allowlisted methods reach the wallet
REAL WALLET on Base: a WITNESS asks before the network switch; CANCEL on the staging gate asks the wallet nothing and sends nothing; ASK MY WALLET forwards the switch, then the payment is intercepted

REAL WALLET on a phone in a wallet app: window.ethereum fails (-32603); the second, authorised wallet gets nothing (but a liveness ping on the list) until the visitor picks it, and its eth_requestAccounts waits for the staging gate; with the readers and the wallet fallback unrelated, an intercepted payment stays pending and the real wallet is not asked about it
